feedback_text: Workflow execution is exceptionally fast and the visual dependency graph made complex pipelines intuitive.
Strict human approval gating for external API dispatches gave our infosec team full confidence.
The auto-generated PDF executive reports look polished and ready for board presentation.
Encountered rate limit errors during high-frequency batch processing. Would appreciate smoother retries.
Natural language planning saves hours of manual task chaining each week.
Chart generation works well but would like more customization on color palettes.
The immutable audit log trail is top-notch for SOC2 compliance audits.
